task: Export the Part::Cylinder object named 'Cylinder' from /home/user/Documents/pipe.FCStd to a STEP file at /home/user/exports/pipe.step.
task_grounding: FreeCAD is open with /home/user/Documents/pipe.FCStd, which contains a single Part::Cylinder named 'Cylinder' (Radius 10, Height 40). Click 'Cylinder' in the Model tree to select it. Then use File > Export to export it as STEP. In the file save dialog, navigate to /home/user/exports/ (create the folder if necessary) and set the filename to exactly 'pipe.step'. Make sure the file type is 'STEP (*.step *.stp)'. Click Save. Then press Ctrl+S in FreeCAD to save the FCStd document.

verification.description: STEP file has ISO-10303-21 header and entities
